ChatMessageWire.description: Complete serialized chat record, including persisted hash and timestamps.

ChatSubAgentMessageRequest.description:
One operator input message addressed to a chat-scoped sub-agent.

The answering actor is never accepted here: it is derived from the
authenticated session by the route.

ChatSubAgentTreeWire.description: Canonical tree response used by the projection and HTTP schema export.

ChatThreadWire.description: Complete serialized thread with source-derived links and provenance.

CreateStrategyRequest.description: Request boundary for a new strategy registry entry.

CreateWidgetRequest.description: Request boundary for widget creation; shapes follow WidgetDefinition.

DeliveredDatumWire.description:
Persisted deliveries carried datum fields plus routing metadata.

These are not model-requested calls, so they have no call ID or tool name.
Keep this shape readable without weakening direct tool-result validation.

ExecutionEventWire.description: Execution event fields with the aliases used by ExecutionEvent.as_dict.

LaunchBacktestRequest.description: Request boundary mirroring the harness activation request contract.

LaunchHarnessBacktestRequest.description: The canonical launch body accepted by ``POST /v1/backtests/jobs``.

MessageContent.description: Uniform content for operator input, deliveries, prompts, and results.

NodeInputReceiptWire.description: Node-answer HTTP receipt: durable message plus admission provenance.

OperatorActorKind.description: Who may answer a node's question, as trusted actor kinds.

RecordLinks.description: Explicit links shared by chat, investigation, and execution records.

RunScreenerRequest.description: Request boundary for one screening run of a saved definition.

SaveScreenerRequest.description: Request boundary for one authored screener definition.

SessionMessageWire.description: An immutable message in the caller-supplied session scope and order.

SteeringPercolationWire.description: The steering acknowledgement attached to an accepted chat message.

SubAgentKind.description: The two agent-backed phase kinds; deterministic work is never a sub-agent.

SubAgentNodeWire.description: One chat-scoped sub-agent node and its direct children.

SubAgentStatus.description: Lifecycle status projected for one durable sub-agent.

ToolCorrelation.description: The immutable, exact join to a request in a particular message.

ToolRequest.description: One model-requested operation, without a provider wire representation.

TranscriptItemKind.description: The discriminator carried by one conversation item.
